verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents recurring schedules only inside specific compliance workflows: recurring user access reviews with reminders (docs-6), recurring vendor reviews by risk level (docs-8), and customizable notifications for regular tasks such as quarterly access reviews (docs-13). Daily continuous monitoring runs on a built-in cadence (docs-12), not a user-defined schedule. There is no evidence of a general-purpose way for users to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, missing for 10: user-defined scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, API- or MCP-driven schedule management, custom cron-style triggers, independent corroboration.
